name: Cbp/p300 interacting transactivator with ED-rich tail 2

function.text: CITED2 encodes cbp/p300-interacting transactivator 2. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and transcription corepressor activity. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

function.text: CITED2 encodes cbp/p300-interacting transactivator 2. It functions as a bridge, linking TFAP2 transcription factors and the p300/CBP transcriptional coactivator complex in order to stimulate TFAP2-mediated transcriptional activation. It positively regulates TGF-beta signaling through its association with the SMAD/p300/CBP-mediated transcriptional coactivator complex. It stimulates the peroxisome proliferator-activated receptors PPARA transcriptional activity.
